name: For Each Loop
description: Iterates over every element of an array (or any array-like container), exposing the current Element and Array Index on each pass. Equivalent to a range-based C++ for loop over a TArray.

inputs.name: Array
inputs.description: The array to iterate over. Connect any TArray variable or the output of an array-returning function. The pin type matches the array's element type.

outputs.name: Loop Body
outputs.description: Execution pin that fires once per element with the current element and index bound. Connect the body of the loop here.

outputs.name: Array Element
outputs.description: The current element value. Its type matches the Array pin's element type. Connect to nodes that operate on that type.

outputs.name: Array Index
outputs.description: The index of the current element, starting at 0. Useful for offset calculations or debugging.

outputs.name: Completed
outputs.description: Execution pin that fires after the last element has been processed. Use for cleanup or to chain the next step.
